title: Time Dependence and Time Preference: Implications for Compensation Structure
authors: Doug J. Chung; Byungyeon Kim; Byoung G. Park
eligible_reason: Dynamic structural model of salesforce effort and compensation (time dependence and time preference) estimated by simulated likelihood in MATLAB, with counterfactual compensation plans. No difference-in-differences or event-study design.
design_notes: MAIN.m / ESTIMATE.m / LIKE.m estimate the structural model on agent-day sales and labor hours; CF_1..CF_5 run counterfactual compensation structures (monthly, daily, intermediate, bonus, commission). The regression inventory is empty; the only regress calls are for starting values.
data_files_note: ReadMe.pdf: 'The Non-Disclosure Agreement with the focal firm prohibits sharing of proprietary data, and, thus, we provide a synthetic data set' simulated from the Table 5 parameters.
data_provenance_note: Synthetic agent-day data simulated from the estimated parameters.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text and papers/ checked Nov 2); the OpenAlex abstract in data/frame/mksc.jsonl is a one-sentence summary. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
